h1: What Is an ATS Friendly Resume? Everything You Need to Know
sections: How Applicant Tracking Systems Read Resumes

faqs.q: What is an ATS-friendly resume?
faqs.a: It is a resume formatted so applicant tracking software can read and parse its text, sections, and relevant information reliably.

faqs.q: Why is an ATS-friendly resume important?
faqs.a: It can reduce formatting and parsing problems when an application is processed through an applicant tracking system.

faqs.q: What should I avoid in an ATS resume?
faqs.a: Avoid complex layouts, excessive graphics, text embedded in images, unusual fonts, and other formatting that may interfere with text parsing.

faqs.q: Does an ATS-friendly resume guarantee selection?
faqs.a: No. ATS compatibility helps with machine readability, but employers also consider qualifications, experience, skills, and other application factors.
